name: Enterprise Wilson Storage Link

values.EndLocation: Wilson gas storage facility, Wharton County

researcher_notes: Not an existing row: roster has no Enterprise or Wilson storage line (P0198 Gulf South Coastal Bend Header is a different line). Hydrocarbon Processing, May 2012, says a 65-mile, 36-inch residue gas pipeline from the Yoakum plant to Enterprise's Wilson storage facility was completed April 2012. An OGJ article from July 2010 announced it as 64 miles, 30-inch, so the 30 inch figure is the plan and 36 inch is as built. The EIA August 2026 release (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 649) lists it as a completed intrastate new pipeline, 62 miles, 30 inch, 600 MMcf/d, but dates completion 29 June 2010, which is the announcement date and looks wrong; EIA is one origin and not used for staged values. Length 65 mi clears the 25 km add threshold. Sponsor, endpoints and completion are all sourced. Start year April 2012 per Hydrocarbon Processing (StartYear1 not staged here). Capacity not staged: only EIA's 600 MMcf/d, unconfirmed. Intrastate, so no FERC filing expected; Texas Railroad Commission T-4 not checked. Route not researched. Second independent source for length and diameter not found; the Digital Refining item repeats the same Enterprise release.
